ruleDefinitions.name: Windows PHP Web Server Spawning Command Shell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a web server process (PHP, IIS, Apache) spawning a command shell or utility, which is a common indicator of web shell execution (php2shell).

sequences.name: Web Server Spawning Shell
sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND parent_process_name:("php.exe", "php-cgi.exe", "w3wp.exe", "httpd.exe", "apache.exe", "apache2.exe") AND process_name:("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cscript.exe", "wscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "certutil.exe", "bitsadmin.exe", "curl.exe", "wget.exe", "whoami.exe", "nltest.exe", "ipconfig.exe", "nslookup.exe") AND outcome:"success"
